# The color cleanup retains modern surface tokens beside legacy sidebar wrappers

The committed conversation header uses --color-surface-lower, --color-text-base and --color-surface-border, while other owned consumers use the new sidebar wrappers. layout-border-0 changes to color-neutral-200 and the prefers-contrast branch uses ThreeDShadow. The exact committed/current declarations support these separate component roles; they do not establish a repository-wide preference for either token family or a rendered contrast guarantee.

Scope: Thunderbird conversation header and layout color families.
